parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A circular rubber wheel attached to the cart, used for rolling movement.
parts.Functional_description: Provides traction and allows the cart to move smoothly on surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its central axis to enable forward and backward motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel located on the opposite side of the front axle.
parts.Functional_description: Works in conjunction with the other front wheel to balance and steer the cart.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates freely to support directional control and motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rear wheel made of rubber, part of the cart’s drive or support system.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the rear of the cart and helps maintain stability during movement.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axle to assist in propulsion and balance.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: Another rear wheel made of rubber, paired with the opposite rear wheel.
parts.Functional_description: Ensures even weight distribution and smooth rolling motion.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates in sync with the other rear wheel to maintain balance and motion.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: A structural or accessory component, possibly a support or connector made of aluminum.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural integrity or connects other parts of the cart.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move independently but supports other moving parts.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the cart made of durable plastic, forming the chassis and housing other components.
parts.Functional_description: Supports all other parts, provides seating and structure for the cart.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary relative to the wheels; serves as the main frame of the object.
